🧠 *Eco Driving Tips*

• *Maintain Tyre Pressure*: Keep tyres at the recommended pressure to reduce rolling resistance and improve fuel efficiency.

• *Regular Vehicle Service*: Ensure timely servicing, including cleaning the air filter and using fresh oil, to maintain engine efficiency.

• *Minimize Extra Weight*: Remove unnecessary items from the vehicle and avoid using roof carriers to reduce strain on the engine.

• *Turn Off Engine at Stops*: Switch off the engine during long stops or idling to save fuel and reduce emissions.

• *Use AC Wisely*: Park in shaded areas and vent hot air before using AC. Limit AC usage to improve fuel economy.

• *Plan Trips Efficiently*: Avoid multiple cold starts by planning trips in advance and combining short journeys.

• *Fuel at Trusted Pumps*: Fill fuel only at trusted pumps to ensure quality fuel and optimal engine performance.

For personalized eco checks, you can *Book a Service* or request a callback from a service advisor. Let us help you drive smarter and more sustainably!

messages.message: [service_enquiry] Does my car needs a service it's approx driven to 10000km in 12 months?
messages.response:
🧠
• *Service Timing*
Your car *does need a service* if it has reached *10,000 km or 12 months*, whichever comes first. Since your car is approximately *10,000 km* in *12 months*, it is due for a service.

• *Service Types*
You can opt for:
• *1st Periodic Service* (initial major check-up at ~6 months or 10,000 km)
• *Ongoing Periodic Service* (repeat oil service and filter/wear part replacement)
• *4th Periodic / Major Check* (comprehensive check at ~24 months or ~40,000 km)

• *Cost Estimate*
For a *hatchback*, a general paid service starts at *Rs. 3,999*, while for an *SUV*, it starts at *Rs. 5,499*. The final cost depends on your car’s condition and parts needed.

• *Booking & Pickup*
Our workshop is open *Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM*. Call *+91 98765 43211* for bookings. We also offer *free pickup and drop* within *10 km* of the workshop.

• *Warranty Validity*
Regular servicing keeps your warranty valid. Ensure you get your car serviced on time for optimal performance.
